summary: Migrates React projects and components from Radix UI to Base UI. Use when asked to migrate from radix, move to base-ui, convert radix primitives, or switch a shadcn project's base library.
whenToUse: Use when asked to migrate from radix, move to base-ui, convert radix primitives, or switch a shadcn project's base library.
verification: Each run writes (or fully overwrites) the file for each component it
A multi-component run ("migrate alert-dialog and dropdown-menu") writes one
Whole-project mode writes the per-component files plus
There is NO index file. Migration status is derived from disk, not
